prompt: Gray release rules break on MySQL with utf8mb4 and on empty rule payloads. (1) `GrayReleaseRule.rules` and `ReleaseHistory.operationContext` are mapped as plain strings and hit the 65,535-byte row-size limit; map both as large objects (`@Lob`) — the SQL migration is handled separately. (2) `GrayReleaseRuleItemTransformer.batchTransformFromJSON(content)` returns null for null/empty content or JSON `null`, which later causes NullPointerExceptions when gray rules are loaded (e.g. in `GrayReleaseRulesHolder`); it must return an empty set in those cases.

oracle_plan.instruction: batchTransformFromJSON: return an empty set for null/empty content and when Gson returns null.
